quarterly_data.quarter: Digital Realty press release: Digital Realty Brings Native AI Inference Platform on (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer: Blackfuel selected Digital Realty's BCN1 data center in Barcelona as the foundation for deploying and scaling its AI inference platform - a multi-megawatt deployment built on liquid-cooled Dell Technologies AI Factory infrastructure and AMD GPUs, with Blackfuel's inference platform integrated with ServiceFabric, Digital Realty's software-defined interconnection platform, to deliver AI inference over private connectivity. ServiceFabric extends across more than 800 Digital Realty and third-party data centers worldwide. Per the release, for agentic workflows of 20 to 50 sequential inference API calls, cutting TTFT by 50 milliseconds through ServiceFabric can shorten task completion by 1 to 2.5 seconds versus public internet connectivity. CTO Chris Sharp: 'Barcelona is the first proof point, and we're excited to help Blackfuel scale from here.' No megawatt figure or contract value is stated.
quarterly_data.figure: multi-megawatt deployment at BCN1 (Barcelona); ServiceFabric across more than 800 data centers; no value stated
